meta.name: agent-reach
meta.description: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Install and configure upstream tools for Twitter/X, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu, Douyin, LinkedIn, Boss直聘, RSS, and any web page — then call them directly. Use when: (1) setting up platform access tools for the first time, (2) checking which platforms are available, (3) user asks to configure/enable a platform channel. Triggers: "帮我配", "帮我添加", "帮我安装", "agent reach", "install channels", "configure twitter", "enable reddit".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为AI助手安装并配置各平台数据源工具
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为AI助手快速接入社交媒体和网页数据源。
copy.tagline_en: Install and configure upstream tools for your AI agent to access multiple platforms.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly connect your AI agent to social media and web data sources.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以帮你配置并直接调用 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub、Bilibili、小红书、抖音、LinkedIn、Boss直聘、RSS 等平台的工具，读取内容或搜索信息。
howto.when: 当你第一次设置平台工具、询问有哪些平台可用，或要求配置/启用某个平台通道时触发。

say.text: 帮我配一下 Twitter 的 cookies。
帮我安装 Reddit 通道。
say.note: Claude 会运行安装命令并检查状态。
Claude 会执行配置步骤并提示你导入 cookies。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you configure and directly call tools for Twitter/X, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu, Douyin, LinkedIn, Bosszhipin, RSS, and any web page to read content or search.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you first set up platform tools, ask which platforms are available, or request to configure/enable a specific channel.

say_en.note: Claude will guide you to export Cookie-Editor string and configure it.

say_en.text: Install the Reddit channel for me.
say_en.note: Claude will run install commands and check status.
Claude will execute configuration steps and prompt you to import cookies.
